name: Visit 联盟商店 and buy only a 名称含统帅经验 item
goal: Read 联盟商店's stock on the live client -- a page that is NOT reachable from the 商店 nav -- name every item from its own purchase overlay, buy exactly the slots the operator's policy names (名称含「统帅经验」) and nothing else, sweeping the list with a swipe because it is longer than one screen.
preconditions: the client is on any page from which the HOME bottom nav can be reached (<=3 bounded back presses)
the 联盟 nav item is readable in the bottom band (exact token 联盟, 5th of 6)
the ALLIANCE page's tile grid renders (>=4 of its 8 tile names readable)
device lease held by a development owner, and AUTO has actually yielded (wait_for_the_device) -- a lease is a request, not a handover (measured 6 s and 22 s on two 2026-10-05 passes)
required_vision: NAV_ALLIANCE_联盟 (HOME bottom nav, exact text; the ALLIANCE page's own header also reads 联盟, at y=41 -- the band filter keeps them apart)
TILE_联盟商店 (the ALLIANCE page's 2x4 tile grid; measured centre (246,938) on 720x1280)
SHOP_HEADER_联盟商店 (the shop page's own header, y=42, i.e. inside the top 12% of the frame)
SHOP_BANNER_下次刷新 (the self-refresh countdown, y=151 -- this page's second identity marker)
SHOP_TABS_今日/本周 (bottom band at y=1241..1246, i.e. inside y>=0.93*H=1190)
CARD_ANCHOR_剩余：N (one per card; 3 columns at x~139/360/580, rows at y=381/665/948 unscrolled)
OVERLAY_确定购买 with its orange price button (measured bbox [222,795,276,71], centre (361,831)) and its own ✕ (measured (654,431))
WALLET_ONE_NUMBER_ONLY (the single top-bar figure at x~630; the store's 钻石 slot at x~451 is NOT rendered here)
required_actions: reach the ALLIANCE page: tap the OCR box of the exact token 联盟 in the HOME bottom band, or a bounded back press then re-check (the store page must be left first: its bottom bar has no 联盟)
find the 联盟商店 tile from a fresh frame (up to 3 attempts -- the tile grid fades in) and tap its own OCR box; never a stored coordinate
confirm the shop page from BOTH its header (y<0.12*H) and its 下次刷新 banner
sweep: read the cards, open each card's own 确定购买 overlay to learn its name (the cards print no name), decide, and CLOSE the overlay before moving on
swipe up inside the grid to reveal the row the screen clipped, keeping only cards whose anchor is deeper than the deepest one already inspected -- derived from the frame, never a constant
buy only on 名称含统帅经验, through the client's own two-tap confirmation
verification: the item name is read from the client's own 确定购买 overlay, never from an icon guess -- 联盟商店's cards show icon + 剩余 + price and no name at all
the overlay seen by card N is proven to be card N's own: open_purchase refuses to read an overlay that was already on screen before it tapped, and every non-spending path closes the overlay it opened
BUY is reachable ONLY from a name containing 统帅经验, and 英雄经验 must never satisfy it (measured: the two bottles are one character apart)
the spend witness is the single top-bar number (x~630), read before and after; the store's 钻石 slot does not exist on this page
the pass ends with no purchase overlay armed (an armed dialog is what a later tap could spend from)
failure_conditions: ALLIANCE_SHOP_DID_NOT_OPEN: the tile grid is still on screen
recovery: a card whose overlay will not open is reported NOT_EXECUTED and nothing at all is tapped for it
a leftover overlay (one already on screen before this card was tapped) is closed by its own ✕ before anything else, so it can never be read as this card's own
the body ladder is clamped to stay strictly above the bottom band, so a tap can never select 今日/本周 by accident -- the 4th row's anchor sits close to that band
the quantity slider on the overlay is never touched: the +/− controls sit above the price button and a stray tap on + was measured changing 4,000 to 20,000
every swipe is issued inside the grid, above the 今日/本周 strip, so no control is ever touched by one

failure_patterns: the ghost overlay (FIXED 2026-10-05): the decision branch dismissed only on non-BUY, so a BUY verdict in a read-only pass left 确定购买 armed, the next card's inspection found an orange button already on screen and reported the previous card's name and price as its own, taps aimed at later cards landed inside the open dialog (one hit + and set the amount to 5x), and the pass ended with the dialog armed.  Measured cost of the bug on this page: it turned a roll with TWO 统帅经验 slots into one reporting SEVEN, i.e. it would have bought five items that are not 统帅经验 while believing they were -- 1小时研究加速 @ 26,000, 5分钟训练加速 @ 1,300, 5分钟治疗加速 @ 2,200 and two others.  Fixed in two places on purpose: every non-spending path now closes the overlay, AND open_purchase refuses to read an overlay that was already on screen before it tapped.  Pinned by a structural AST test whose first version passed on the buggy code -- mutation-testing it by restoring the elif is what exposed that, and the test now checks the branch's SHAPE (the dismiss must be unconditional), not merely that a dismiss appears somewhere

the substring trap: the ALLIANCE page's own third-row tile is named 联盟商店, i.e. the same four characters as the shop page's header.  A page predicate keyed on the name alone would fire on both, so on_alliance_shop_page requires the header inside the top 12% AND the 下次刷新 banner

the two experience bottles: 英雄经验 (the Exp bottle that stands alone in the store's art) does not contain 统帅经验, so a rule written against the operator's words skips it -- but a rule keyed on 经验, or read off the icon, would spend on it.  This is the same near-miss the 游荡商人 module already documents
the single top-bar number: there is no 钻石 slot on this page, so a verifier that reads the *first* number as diamonds, or expects two numbers, reports nonsense about a correct pass

the list is longer than the screen: the unscrolled frame shows three complete rows and clips a fourth, so a name-based rule evaluated from one frame silently misses a row.  The sweep keeps only rows deeper than the deepest already inspected, and stops on its own when a swipe reveals nothing

the overlay's quantity slider: a stray tap on + changed the amount from 4,000 to 20,000.  The slider is never touched deliberately, and the ghost-overlay guard is what stops a card-directed tap from ever reaching it
